in_marathi.name: Sanwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of the Mountains
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sanwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sanwar is a Hindu name that means 'God of the Mountains'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'San' meaning 'God' and 'War' meaning 'Mountain'. This name is a reflection of the power and strength found in nature and is often given to boys who are believed to possess similar qualities.
